unmapped_findings: 15Mn5Ni alloy in the HR+CR+1023 K condition failed in tension in a brittle, crack-initiation-controlled manner with a quasi-cleavage fracture surface bearing many microcracks, distinct from the dimple (ductile) fracture of 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni at the same condition.
The processing temperature window for 15Mn5Ni alloy to attain an optimum strength-ductility combination was concluded to be around 1173 K, not 1023 K; at 973 K and 1023 K the alloy was brittle.

Note on internal inconsistency: block b0062 refers to 15Mn5Ni specimens heat treated at '973 K and 1073 K' displaying negligible ductility (<1%), whereas the same condition is given as 1023 K elsewhere (b0031, b0034, b0060); the 1073 K appears to be a typographical inconsistency.
